payload.text: 3.3.0, THE ONE NEXT RELEASE (hv directive 1, decision 109): the train. OWED BY hv: the ratification of ST0092's terms document (todo 76); the shape of issue 0665, which the issue leaves to its reporter (by the census of 2026-11-01 the exemption it names passes 241 rows on completed threads across the fleet, so a check that reads every completed thread would name all of them); and the answer on client names (watchout 34). FIRST TRAIN, on booked runs: the three banked fixes (todo 74), then the push of main (hold 8). cc's LANE: issue 0671, then ST0092's WP-02 to WP-09. dc's LANE: issues 0673 and 0674, which are the banked testkit fixes; ST0091's four packages, since the cut goes through devbin's core; issue 0670 in the shape its record carries since 6c2d21e8b, judged with the fleet census at refs/bank/vc/0670/ and bound to redden Devbin ST0011 AT-3.5 and nothing else; issue 0665 once hv has ruled its shape; and issue 0649, measured first. ic's LANE: issue 0661 in the shape its record calls (B), then 0650, then 0672 in the full shape (todo 75), and for ST0092 the read of each of cc's surface rows and WP-10. BEFORE THE CUT: hv says which remotes it pushes to and release.remotes is declared (watchout 33); hv sees ST0090's row on a 3.3.0 build (hold 6); every package and issue above is landed and its gate read. THE CUT is hv's, once. AFTER IT: ST0092's sweep. Each lane's order is in its inbox, amended on 2026-11-10 before any session had read it; cc, dc and ic have no session running until hv starts them.
